about: Law Offices of Robert Sheldon is a immigration firm with four offices across Florida, including Coral Gables, Oakland Park and Pompano Beach.
The firm publishes little about cost or availability on the pages we read. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: This firm names no attorney on the pages we could read, so there is nobody to look up. The register itself exists: Florida publishes its attorney discipline as court decisions and we read them for the other firms in this market.

G3.evidence: LAW OFFICES OF ROBERT SHELDON, LLC is an active FLAL on the Florida register, document L11000114099, filed 2011-10-05, with 4 Google-verified locations
G3.source: Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.
